en: Now, in this course, we will start by first
taking a look at the general setup and
configuration of Codex, no matter which
approach you use
besides cloud, that will come a bit later.
We'll then have a look at the general usage
and different ways of using Codex. And very
important, we'll talk about security and
permission management and how you can make
sure that you're using this very powerful
tool in a secure way.
And then thereafter, in the second part of
the course, so to say,
we'll dive a bit deeper. We'll dive into
some more advanced usage patterns and
examples. We'll learn how you can use Codex
for code reviews and which built-in tools it
has to help you with code reviews and
understanding changes in your code. We'll
explore agent skills, automations, and more,
including how to run tasks in the cloud. And
we'll do all that whilst working on an
example project.
